story_info.title: Toby Turtle's Clean Lake Day
story_info.subtitle: A small friend helps nature.
story_info.moral: It is good to help keep nature clean.

main_character.name: Toby Turtle
main_character.appearance: Toby is a young sea turtle with a rounded teal-green shell patterned in soft swirls, gentle brown eyes, and smooth blue-green flippers. He has a calm, unhurried expression.

cover.prompt: A cheerful young sea turtle named Toby, with a rounded teal-green shell patterned in soft swirls, gentle brown eyes, and smooth blue-green flippers, swimming in clear blue water. He is gently looking at a green plant with a small, shiny blue wrapper caught on it. The light is warm and cinematic, reflecting off the water.
cover.visual_action: Toby Turtle looking at litter on a plant

slides.title: Toby's Morning Swim
slides.text: Toby Turtle loved the lake. It was a bright, sunny morning. He swam slowly in Crystal Lake. He saw many colourful fish swimming by. He saw tall, green water plants swaying gently. "Slow and steady discovers wonders!" he thought. He felt very happy in his beautiful home.
slides.speaker_notes: Introduce Toby Turtle and his love for Crystal Lake on a beautiful morning.

slides.title: A Sad Plant
slides.text: Toby swam deeper, exploring the clear water. He saw a very pretty plant with big leaves. But wait! Something blue was stuck to it. It was a shiny, crinkly wrapper. The plant looked a little sad with the wrapper on it. Toby knew litter did not belong in the lake.
slides.speaker_notes: Introduce the small challenge: a piece of litter on a plant.

slides.title: Toby's Idea
slides.text: Toby stopped to think. He was a very patient turtle. He wanted to help the plant feel better. He knew he had to be gentle. He slowly moved his strong blue-green flippers. He got ready to take the wrapper off. He took a tiny breath.
slides.speaker_notes: Show Toby thinking and preparing to solve the problem gently.

slides.title: Helping Hands (or flippers!)
slides.text: Very carefully, Toby opened his mouth. He took the blue wrapper gently. He did not pull the plant. He held the wrapper softly in his mouth. Then, he swam slowly to the lake's edge. He put the wrapper on the sand, far away from the water.
slides.speaker_notes: Show Toby taking action to remove the litter safely.

slides.title: A Happy Lake
slides.text: Now the big plant was free! It swayed happily in the clean water. The lake looked even more beautiful. Toby felt so warm inside. He helped his Crystal Lake home. He kept it safe for all the fish and plants. "Slow and steady discovers wonders!" he smiled proudly.
slides.speaker_notes: Conclude with the happy outcome and Toby's positive feeling about helping nature.

instagram.caption:
What if a tiny piece of trash made a big plant sad? 🐢 Dive into a gentle adventure with Toby Turtle this Thursday morning! As Toby swims through his beloved Crystal Lake, he finds a shiny blue wrapper stuck on a beautiful water plant. It looks so sad! Toby, with his patient and thoughtful heart, knows exactly what to do. This heartwarming story teaches children the joy of caring for nature and keeping our beautiful world clean, one gentle flipper at a time. It shows how even small actions can make a big difference! 💖
📚 Save this story for your next reading time.
